document: OpenDataRemoval Privacy Platform — Agent Sprint Plan
description: Executable sprint plan for a coding agent. Each task specifies exact files to create, implementation notes, and commands to verify completion. 7 sprints of 5 days each.

how_to_use: Process tasks in sprint order. Do not start Sprint N+1 until all Sprint N gate_checks pass.
Each task has a 'verify' block — run every command before marking done.
Tasks marked 'blocking: true' must complete before any other task in the same sprint.
Each task 'reference' field names the source document section to read before coding.
Commit after each completed task: git add -A && git commit -m 'S{sprint}-T{n}: {title}'
agent_instructions.path_convention: All paths relative to project root
agent_instructions.env_access: Read secrets from .env via python-dotenv or os.environ — never hardcode

tasks.title: Profiles router — CRUD, field versioning, archive deletion
implementation_notes: All 8 endpoints from DOC-5.routers.profiles
POST /api/profiles: max 5 profiles enforced, all PII encrypted via model TypeDecorator, audit_log=profile_created
POST /api/profiles/{id}/fields: stamp effective_to=now() + is_current=False on existing same type+subtype before inserting new row
DELETE /api/profiles/{id}: execute 8-step archive transaction from DOC-3.schemas.archive.deletion_sequence in single db.begin() block. Two audit_log entries.
PATCH is_paused=True: suspends automation. is_paused=False: schedules catch-up scan within 24h via Celery ETA.

tasks.title: Brokers router and HMAC-authenticated n8n webhook
implementation_notes: POST /api/webhooks/n8n: extract X-Homeguard-Signature header. Compute sha256=hex(hmac.new(N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET.encode(), request_body, sha256).hexdigest()). Use hmac.compare_digest() for constant-time compare. Reject 401 if missing/invalid.
Upsert: INSERT INTO registry.brokers ON CONFLICT (canonical_domain) DO UPDATE SET ... WHERE excluded.field IS DISTINCT FROM brokers.field
If payload contains playbook_json: validate against schema.json, insert broker_playbooks version+1 is_active=True, set prior is_active=False
Return {success:true, upserted:N, skipped:N, errors:N}
POST /api/brokers/{id}/playbooks/{pid}/activate: atomic swap in single transaction

tasks.title: Browser pool, anti-detection, and startup sequence
implementation_notes: pool.py: BrowserPool. Launch chromium with args from DOC-8.service_startup.chromium_launch_args including --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled
Per-context: randomised UA from user_agents.json (weighted: Chrome 65%, Safari 20%, Firefox 15%), viewport random 1280-1920 x 720-1080
add_init_script on each page: sets navigator.webdriver=undefined, mocks navigator.plugins.length > 0, mocks chrome.runtime
acquire() → returns available context or None. release(ctx) → returns to pool. Pool size from PLAYWRIGHT_POOL_SIZE env (default 3).
user_agents.json: chrome_windows (20), chrome_mac (10), chrome_linux (8), safari_mac (10), safari_ios (8), firefox_windows (8), firefox_mac (6)

tasks.title: Token resolver (SafeDict) and all 16 action handlers
implementation_notes: token_resolver.py: class SafeDict(dict): def __missing__(self, key): log.warning(f'Token {key} not found'); return ''. resolve(template, tokens) -> template.format_map(SafeDict(derived_tokens(tokens)))
derived_tokens: add first_name/last_name from full_name, city/state/zip from address_full, dob_month/dob_year from date_of_birth
actions.py: each action is async def handle_{action}(page, step, profile_tokens, dry_run) -> StepResult
submit: if dry_run: return StepResult(status='skipped', dry_run_skipped=True). Else: await click + wait networkidle.
fill_form: iterate values dict, fill each selector with 200ms sleep between fields
conditional: count = await page.locator(selector).count(); if > 0: execute step.steps recursively
screenshot.py: path = f'/app/screenshots/{profile_id}/{broker_id}/{datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")}_{step_id}_{type}.png'. os.makedirs(dir, exist_ok=True).

tasks.title: PlaybookExecutor — phase loop, confirmation, CAPTCHA, error classification
implementation_notes: executor.py: PlaybookExecutor.run(job, context) -> JobResult. Validate playbook JSON Schema first.
Phase loop: for phase in playbook.phases → navigate url_template → for step in phase.steps → dispatch to actions.py → check confirmation + captcha after each navigate/submit
on_failure handlers: stop → set outcome=error return. skip_phase → log continue. mark_manual → set outcome=requires_manual return.
Always capture auto-screenshot on any exception regardless of step.screenshot flag
error_classifier.py: map playwright exceptions to error_type from DOC-8.error_classification. Each returns ErrorResult with recovery_hint.
confirmation.py: async check_text(page, patterns) and check_url(page, url_patterns) and check_negative(page, patterns). Combined per match_strategy.

tasks.title: Async job API — submit, poll, cancel, list endpoints
implementation_notes: job_manager.py: JobManager with jobs: dict[str, JobState]. Background asyncio task evicts jobs older than 1 hour.

POST /jobs/scan and POST /jobs/optout: try acquire() — if None return 503 with retry_after_ms=10000. Start asyncio.create_task(executor.run(job, context)). Return {job_id, status: queued, estimated_duration_ms}.
estimated_duration_ms: simple=15000, multi_step=45000, complex=120000
GET /jobs/{id}: return JobResult or current progress. 404 if evicted.
DELETE /jobs/{id}: task.cancel(), release(context), status=cancelled.

tasks.title: Scan tasks — dispatch chain, scan_broker, analytics chord callback
task_order: 1. scan_broker(profile_id, broker_id, scan_run_id): fetch playbook + decrypt fields → POST playwright /jobs/scan → poll every 5s → on found: create exposure row + dispatch execute_removal_request.delay() → publish Redis SSE event → update scan_run counters
2. compute_post_scan_analytics(results, profile_id, scan_run_id): chord callback — compute score formula — insert exposure_scores + daily_broker_snapshots rows — create new_exposure notifications
3. dispatch_profile_scan(profile_id, scan_run_id): chord(group([scan_broker.s(p,b,r) for b in brokers_batches_10]) | compute_post_scan_analytics.s(p,r))
4. dispatch_daily_scan(): create scan_run row — group([dispatch_profile_scan.s(p,r) for active non-paused profiles])
5. dispatch_verification_scan(profile_id, broker_id, request_id, vscan_id): targeted scan — on still_listed: create relisting_events + new removal_request(parent_request_id=original)
tasks.conftest_fake_playwright: Add fake_playwright_service fixture to conftest.py: FastAPI server on random port, set_next_outcome(outcome, fields=[]) configures next GET /jobs/{id} response. Override PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL.

tasks.title: Removal request tasks — web form, email, legal letter, follow-up

implementations.execute_removal_request: Route by removal_method. Write audit_log BEFORE dispatch. Schedule followup ETA = now() + broker.estimated_response_days * 86400.
implementations.submit_web_form_optout: Call playwright /jobs/optout. Poll. On confirmed: status=pending_confirmation. On captcha: status=requires_manual + flag broker.
implementations.send_removal_email: Render Jinja2 (broker template first, generic fallback). SMTP send. Store Message-ID. audit_log=removal_email_sent BEFORE smtp.sendmail().
implementations.generate_and_send_legal_letter: Render HTML template. WeasyPrint PDF. Save to /app/screenshots/legal/{request_id}.pdf. audit_log=legal_letter_generated BEFORE send. Email with PDF attachment.
implementations.followup_removal_request: Skip if status in (confirmed_removed, verified_removed, requires_manual, failed). INSERT followups row. Re-dispatch method task. If followup_number==3 and no response: status=requires_manual + notification.
implementations.process_email_classification: confirmed_removal → schedule verification ETA 14 days. rejection → failed. info_requested → requires_manual. verification_link → dispatch click_verification_link. unclassified → action_required notification.

tasks.title: Mailwatcher — IMAP poll, email parser, two-stage classifier, patterns
key_implementation_notes: imap_client.py: IMAPClient with IMAP4_SSL. poll() fetches UNSEEN. Cap at 50 per cycle. COPY to Processed then STORE \Deleted + EXPUNGE.
classifier.py: Stage 1 — prefilter_keywords = union of all keywords across all types. Stage 2 — regex per type in priority: verification_link first, then confirmed_removal, info_requested, rejection.
patterns.yml hot-reload: stat() each poll, if mtime changed re-read + recompile all regex patterns.
deduplication: SELECT id FROM mail.inbound_messages WHERE message_id_header = %s. Skip if found.
link_extractor.py: score each URL — positive for /verify /confirm /optout in path, domain matches from_domain. Negative for tracking pixels, mailchimp domains. Highest score wins.
On verification_link: dispatch click_verification_link.delay(request_id, url, broker_id, profile_id) via celery.send_task()

tasks.title: Apply host security hardening — UFW, fail2ban, GPG backup
commands_to_run: sudo ufw default deny incoming && sudo ufw default allow outgoing && sudo ufw allow ssh
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 3000 comment 'OpenDataRemoval Dashboard'
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 8000 comment 'OpenDataRemoval API'
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 5678 comment 'n8n UI'

tasks.title: Run all 12 security verification checks
tasks.description: Execute every check from DOC-12.security_verification_checklist. All 12 must return expected output.

checks.cmd: for i in $(seq 11); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"x","password":"x"}'; done | tail -1

tasks.title: Configure backup schedule and verify restore
steps: Finalise scripts/backup.sh with 7-step procedure from DOC-12.backup_procedures.full_backup
Install quarterly reminder: (crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo '0 9 1 */3 * echo OpenDataRemoval 90-day review due >> /var/log/opendataremoval_reminders.log') | crontab -
Verify backup: gpg --decrypt $(ls -t /var/backups/opendataremoval/*.gpg | head -1) | tar tz | head -5

tasks.title: Final test suite run — all 13 critical paths

commands: cd e2e && npx playwright test --grep @critical 2>&1 | tail -3

commands: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"admin","password":"'$ADMIN_PASSWORD'"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["token"])')

curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/system/stats -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin)['data']; print('profiles:', d['profiles_count'], '| requests:', d['total_removal_requests'], '| brokers:', d['brokers_monitored'])"
